text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон wins the Japan Cup. Narita
Brian
may have lost the race, but she
hasn't lost the
fight in her yet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон tells Нарита Брайан that she's
the only
person who can match her as an
opponent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан, having chased after her
sister's
shadow for so long, now turns her
focus to Hishi
Amazon. She won't
relinquish the Arima Kinen to
her—and
that's a promise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
